lede: Michigan carries the stronger underlying team rating — +5.4 against +2.1, a 3.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Michigan -1.1 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Michigan winning 53% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is pass defense, where Michigan leads Iowa by 47 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 83% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.

items.label: market disagreement
items.text: The market disagrees by 3.4 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.

items.label: sample
items.text: College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
